{{Quote|Stealth is the greatest tool of the Sith assassin.|[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]|<ref name="NEGVV">''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>}}
The '''''Bloodfin''''' was the personal [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] speeder of [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and a modified [[Razalon/Legends|Razalon]] [[FC-20 speeder bike/Legends|FC-20 speeder bike]]. As his predecessors had done during the [[New Sith Wars]], it was named after an animal that personified the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. In Maul's case, his speeder was named after a [[Bloodfin (creature)|fierce aquatic hunter]] he had once encountered and fought on an ocean world in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Sith_Speeder_Tatooine.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Maul on the ''Bloodfin''.]]
As with many other [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bikes, the ''Bloodfin'' was a small repulsorlift vehicle with a powerful rear thrust engine. Its engine systems were designed to provide the rider with fast acceleration and allowed it to reach maximum open-ground speed within seconds. Its design gave it an extremely low center of gravity, improved its cornering ability greatly and presented enemies with a very small target.

The vehicle was unarmed since the Sith Lord preferred to use the ''Bloodfin'' to pursue enemies and deal with them once having caught up with them. The vehicle's curved seat allowed Darth Maul to leap from the vehicle by just rocking forward, allowing him to enter into combat immediately and take his enemy by surprise.

The ''Bloodfin'' was also equipped with an auto-brake feature which brought the vehicle to a safe stop whenever the handle bars were released, ensuring that it did not crash or collapse following one of Maul's sudden dismounts. The vehicle also had no shields or sensors since they were considered as a sign of weakness by the Sith Lord.

The ''Bloodfin'' was also equipped with an auto-piloting system which allowed Darth Maul to remotely pilot the vehicle through the use of his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. He could also use a wrist-mounted comlink to control the vehicle from up to eight kilometers away.

==History==
[[File:Maul-bloodfin.jpg|thumb|right|180px|[[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] piloting ''Bloodfin''.]]
Besides the ''Bloodfin'', Darth Maul owned several speeders including a T-shaped speeder destroyed during a duel with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Anoon Bondara]] shortly before the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] and an assault speeder equipped with [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and a personal [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], while seeking out [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], Darth Maul used the ''Bloodfin'' to combat Master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]. Having jumped from the speeder, it presumably halted due to the auto-brake feature and was used by Maul to return to his starship [[Scimitar/Legends|''Scimitar'']]. Following Maul's presumed death at the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] at the hands of Qui-Gon's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], the ''Bloodfin'' was confiscated by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] authorities along with his [[Scimitar/Legends|starship]] though they both later mysteriously disappeared forever. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] obtained a [[Garth Ezzar's speeder bike|similar speeder bike]].<ref name="Destruction">{{LivingForce|Heart of Evil: Destruction}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
''Bloodfin'' was also the name of a server&mdash;or "Galaxy"&mdash;in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.
